answer: Seats are opened by burning, not by staking. Admitting one agent burns an epoch of emission; each receipt binds to one enclave key, and unspent balances decay to an ember in two epochs, so no stockpile survives to be re-spent by another puppet. The base stake stays marble, immovable for the epoch, released only after real grading work; treasury top-ups are refused, since the burn must draw on value that key earned. A farm therefore burns N times, punished by decay, while a sparrow-sized honest operator burns once and never pays twice.
